UserAccount.title: User Account & Text File Record
UserAccount.description: Synced user account profile, Password/PIN credential, theme preference, and full plain-text user file stored in Firestore.

userTextFile.description: Complete user account information formatted in plain text (username, PIN, city, role, email, phone, theme, etc.)

UserFile.title: Individual User Text File
UserFile.description: Dedicated per-user text file document (<username>.txt) containing username, PIN, city, role, email, phone, and theme in plain text form.

userInfoText.description: Single-line readable summary of all user information (username, PIN, city, role, email, phone, theme)

fileContentText.description: Full multi-line plain-text file content for this user

LoginEvent.title: Login & Account Creation Event
LoginEvent.description: Append-only audit record of every account creation and sign-in event. Viewable only by the Admin.

eventType.description: NEW ACCOUNT CREATED or USER SIGN-IN ALERT

savedTheme.description: User's saved theme mode at login

AdminMailLog.title: Admin Mail Log
AdminMailLog.description: Append-only record of immediate email reports dispatched to krsmcxofficial@gmail.com. Viewable only by the Admin.

Announcement.title: Official App Announcement
Announcement.description: Live announcement controlled by the Admin from the database and displayed in real time inside the app.

isActive.description: Whether announcement is active in the app

AppUpdateConfig.title: App OTA Update Configuration
AppUpdateConfig.description: Admin-controlled remote app update configuration stored in Firestore for WhatsApp/Instagram-style in-app updates.

latestVersionCode.description: Latest published versionCode; prompts users when greater than installed BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE

apkDownloadUrl.description: Direct APK or release download URL

releaseNotes.description: What's new notes shown in the in-app update dialog

isForceUpdate.description: If true, requires update before continuing

isUpdateEnabled.description: Master switch to enable or disable the update prompt

UpdateEntry.title: App Update Release Entry
UpdateEntry.description: Individual app release stored in the /updates collection so every new update is persisted with full version history.

apkDownloadUrl.description: Direct APK or release download URL

releaseNotes.description: What's new notes for this release

isUpdateEnabled.description: Whether this release is active for OTA delivery

targetUsername.description: Optional @username for targeted user rollout; empty for all users

AppInstallation.title: User App Installation Telemetry
AppInstallation.description: Tracks each user's current installed app version and device model.

/user_accounts/{accountId}.description: Stores synced user accounts and their plain-text file representation keyed by normalized username.

/user_files/{accountId}.description: Stores each user in their own dedicated text file document (<username>.txt) containing username, PIN, city, role, email, phone, and theme in plain text form.

/login_events/{eventId}.description: Append-only login & account creation audit log. Readable/listable ONLY by the Admin.

/admin_mail_logs/{mailId}.description: Append-only mail report log addressed to krsmcxofficial@gmail.com. Readable/listable ONLY by the Admin.

/announcements/{announcementId}.description: Admin-controlled live announcements streamed into the app.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Stores Admin-controlled remote app update configuration (`app_update`) streamed into the app.

/updates/{updateId}.description: Dedicated updates collection storing every published app update release and version history.

/app_installations/{installId}.description: Tracks per-user installed app version telemetry.
